title: Attach a disclosure statement to off-the-plan contracts
what: As the vendor under an off-the-plan contract, attach a disclosure statement in the approved form (including a draft plan) before the purchaser signs.

sources.title: Conveyancing Act 1919 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: a vendor under an off the plan contract must, before the contract is signed by or on behalf of the purchaser, attach to the contract a disclosure statement in the approved form
